title: Chia tỷ lệ thời gian của tín hiệu
vision_description: The page contains a title, a brief description, and three diagrams illustrating signal time scaling. The title is at the top, followed by a description with mathematical expressions. Below are three diagrams showing different time-scaled signals.
main_message: The page explains the concept of time scaling of signals, demonstrating how a signal changes when its time axis is scaled.

definitions.definition: The process of compressing or expanding the time axis of a signal.

examples: The diagrams show how a signal f(t) is transformed into ϕ(t) = f(2t) and ϕ(t) = f(t/2).

charts.description: Three diagrams showing the original signal and its time-scaled versions.

bilingual_aliases: Chia tỷ lệ thời gian của tín hiệu: Time scaling of signals
uncertain_content: The exact mathematical expressions in the description are partially obscured.
